verdicts.rationale: Original claim assumed that including 'ids' parameter alongside 'filter' in delete request was problematic behavior. Analysis reveals this is standard Go library behavior: ShouldBindBodyWith with binding.JSON silently ignores unknown JSON fields during unmarshaling. CollectionFilterReq struct (request_v2.go:317-323) defines only 'filter' as required, with no 'ids' field. Source code confirms delete handler (handler_v2.go:1202-1213) extracts only httpReq.Filter and passes it to DeleteRequest Expr field. Observed behavior: POST /entities/delete with filter='id > 0' and ids=[1,2,3] correctly deletes 1 record matching filter, not all ids. No contract constraint requires 'ids' to be validated or rejected. This is mundane HTTP API semantics, not a defect.
